analysis:
This batch is documentation only. CHANGELOG.md receives the v0.10.4 candidate section, and the changelog.d/*.md fragments are removed, apparently folded into that section. The changelog head units 25-26 that I examined are older historical release notes at lines 2614-3280, with no changed ranges visible in them. The patch excerpt shows the new v0.10.4 section at lines 11-171. Only the first part of it is visible, including rollout notes that mention a prompt_anchor_mismatch window. No source code, wire protocol, key handling, attestation or authorization logic changes in the supplied evidence, so I flag no security regression.

Items for integration to confirm:
- The new v0.10.4 section is truncated in the patch excerpt, so I could not see its claims in full. Integration should check that the folded text does not misstate security-relevant facts. Examples: the delta checkpoint writes to the SSD prefix cache (T-041, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS) and the traffic-verdict re-registration behavior (TB-011/T-053/T-057). Another is the JSON response_format grammar constraint and MTP interaction on Qwen (TB-007).
- The documented rollout mismatch (a 0.10.4 provider against a coordinator without the platform#516 change) quarantines cache affinity for up to 10 minutes. The changelog calls this an availability and routing effect with every request still served. The coordinator side is outside the supplied evidence.
- Removal of the CI/console tooling notes does not change runtime controls.
The canonical T-041 text is unchanged by this PR. The delta-checkpoint note concerns on-disk write volume, and the encryption, HMAC naming and TTL controls are not shown changed here.
